slices.focus: A commercial payer quietly changes prior-auth rules; Kelli catches the pattern early and contains it before it spreads.
slices.summary: A commercial payer quietly changes prior-auth documentation requirements, causing a small denial creep. Kelli spots the pattern (same payer, same service type, creeping counts) and reverse-engineers the new requirement from denial language and portal wording. She rewrites the cheat sheet within days, contains the mop-up to a couple sites, and realizes her denial-control system has reached early-warning maturity. She plans a four-line catch log and targeted payer cheat-sheet spot-checks.
open_loops: Four-line catch log (signal/payer/fix/result) not yet started
Targeted spot-check on highest-risk payer cheat sheets not yet done
System-maturity framing needs to be used in leadership updates
decisions: Kelli is still revenue-cycle lead, and her denial-control system is now mature enough to catch payer rule changes quickl
